title: Esperance — declared route and canonical identity contract
purpose: Reviewable structural scope only. Shared national QA is linked with its actual limits; official source and per-place browser review remain distinct.
coverageNotes: ABS statistical boundary navigation retains source coordinates exactly; it is not the gazetted legal boundary or an address eligibility service.

The Digital Atlas/Geoscape ward layer retains every original polygon part. Its live item says August 2026 while the service description says November 2025; later amendments and individual ward representation require separate reconciliation.

Names and professional roles come independently from the WALGA2026 directory, which states its information is up-to-date as of March2026. Checking the retained source on17October2026 does not establish subsequent currentness. Individual biographies and later vacancies/replacements are not reconciled.
Previous2025 local-election contestant ballots remain unintegrated; no historical winner is inferred to hold current office.

Names and professional roles come independently from the WALGA 2026 directory, which states its information is up-to-date as of March2026. Checking the retained source on 17 October 2026 does not establish subsequent currentness. Individual biographies and later vacancies/replacements are not reconciled.

23 October review: extraordinary-election process verified. Existing current roster requires follow-up for vacancies and replacements; do not treat the old roster as freshly certified. Individual accepted ballots not yet entered.
Declared scope is this place route, visible implementation date, breadcrumbs, choices and canonical place identity/boundary pins only.
This manifest does not claim a complete civic journey, current source/legal correctness, full biographies or full historical contestant coverage.
Geometry, people, candidate measures and timing received only the actual checks recorded in the linked national report; their missing coverage remains explicit there.

Browser evidence is a shared-renderer smoke review of its recorded fixtures and viewport/device conditions. It does not establish full per-place source, geometry, mobile, accessibility or browser review.
No new Twinkles were authored; grassroots implementation remains open. A structural PASS is not a national completeness claim.
